AC-5: #286 does not move ADR 0069 to Accepted, does not update shared ADR indexes/manifests, and does not claim #207/#288 or WP-18C closeout.
AC-6: Fresh exact-head review has no unresolved actionable findings, required CI is green on the published head, and typed finish derives terminal authority.
